evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.isolation: Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, the diff and git history were not read.

sources.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.

After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).
The reduction *fraction* is `1 - m(R) = R/(100+R)` ... `R_final = max(0, (R - r_flat)*(1 - r_pct/100)*(1 - p) - f)`; mitigation `m(R) = 100/(100+R)`.

**Black Cleaver average stacks** (`ArmorReductionEffect.average_reduction`): the established model uses a fixed `0.8*max_stacks` constant ... the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp `min(k, C)` over `h` hits is `C - C(C-1)/(2h)` for `h >= C`.

sources.quote: "factor": 0.6 for a 40% Grievous Wounds cut; "venom_factor": 0.65 for the sourced 35% shield cut - repo convention: a `factor` is the multiplier actually applied to the quantity it accompanies.

sources.where: data/champions.json (per-champion stats.armor flat/perLevel) + CLAUDE.md growth formula base + growth*(L-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(L-1))
sources.quote: Level-18 base armor of typical bruiser/tank targets: Darius 125.4, Hecarim 124.65, Leona 124.60; level-20: Fiora/Sett 125.43, Trundle 125.49, Lee Sin/Yorick 124.49. Minimum base armor in the game at level 1 is 18 (Cassiopeia, Malzahar, Taliyah, Veigar).

identification_of_the_leaf.claim: support_resistance_reduction[0] is the ally-held Black Cleaver 'Carve' armor shred forwarded into the coupled roster fight, and `factor` is the damage-amplification multiplier that shred confers on the event's damage (not the retained-resistance multiplier).
reasoning: The key says *resistance reduction*. The only resistance-reduction source anywhere in the scenario's named items is Black Cleaver's Carve (S1). Bloodsong's Expose Weakness (S2) is an increased-damage-taken debuff, not a resistance reduction, and its sourced magnitudes are 8% (melee holder) / 5% (ranged holder) -> 1.08 / 1.05, which neither the old nor the new value resembles.

No support-class champion in data/champions.json carries a percentage resistance reduction; the only champions with explicit % shred are Garen 25%, Sion 25%, Karthus 25% MR, Olaf 20%, Vi 20%, Zoe 30% MR - none of them a support. So the roster's support-side shred is item-sourced (Black Cleaver).

Both old and new values are > 1, so `factor` cannot be the retained-resistance multiplier (that would be 0.94^k down to 0.70, S1+S5); a per-event ledger row reporting 'how much did the ally's shred amplify this event' is the only reading in which values > 1 are meaningful.
Decisive check: both golden values are reproduced by ONE target armor with only the Carve stack count differing (see computation below). That coincidence pins the interpretation.

independent_computation.formula: mitigation m(R) = 100/(100+R) (S3). Amplification from an armor shred of fraction s: amp(R,s) = m(R*(1-s)) / m(R) = (100+R) / (100 + R*(1-s)).
independent_computation.sourced_shred: Carve = 6% armor reduction per stack, 5 stacks max, 30% total (S1). Stacks last 6 s and one is applied per physical-damage instance, so by combat event index 35 the shred is unambiguously at the 5-stack cap.
independent_computation.solve_for_the_old_value_at_the_same_targ: amp(125.0, 0.06) = 225 / 217.5 = 1.0345 -> 1.03 at 2 dp. i.e. the old value is exactly ONE Carve stack (6%) instead of the capped five (30%).
independent_computation.rounding_band: Rounded to 2 dp, factor 1.20 corresponds to R in [122.6, 127.5]; over that whole band the single-stack amp is 1.0342-1.0348, i.e. 1.03. Old and new are therefore the same target with 1 stack vs 5 stacks - not two different targets.
independent_computation.plausibility_of_R_~125: 125 armor is the ordinary level-18/20 base armor of a bruiser/tank target with no armor items (Darius 125.4, Hecarim 124.65, Leona 124.60, Fiora/Sett 125.43 at 20) (S6).
independent_computation.why_the_old_value_is_impossible_under_th: amp(R, 0.30) is strictly increasing in R, and the smallest base armor any champion can have is 18 (S6), giving amp = 1.048. So 1.03 is BELOW the minimum a fully stacked Carve can produce against any champion at any level - it can only arise from crediting a single 6% stack, which contradicts S1 at a late-fight event.
independent_computation.why_the_0.8*max_stacks_approximation_doe: S4's 0.8*max_stacks (4 stacks) constant is a fight-averaged model for the wielder's own aggregate damage; it would give 1.15, and its own recommended replacement (exact Cesaro mean C - C(C-1)/(2h) = 5 - 10/35 = 4.71 stacks -> 28.3% -> 1.187) is likewise an average, not the instantaneous factor for a single event. A per-event row at event index 35 is past the 5-hit ramp, so the instantaneous shred is the wiki cap, 30%.

conclusion: The sourced Black Cleaver shred at combat event 35 is the capped 30% armor reduction; the resulting damage-amplification factor is (100+R)/(100+0.7R), which equals 1.20 at the scenario target's ~125 armor. The old 1.03 corresponds to a single 6% Carve stack and is unreachable for a fully stacked Carve against any champion in the game.
residual_uncertainty: The roster's target armor is not readable from data/ alone (scenario definitions live outside the evidence tree). The verdict rests on (a) the wiki-sourced 30% cap being the correct shred at event 35, and (b) the exact self-consistency of 1.03 (1 stack) and 1.20 (5 stacks) at a single armor value of ~125, which is the ordinary level-18/20 base armor of a bruiser/tank. If the leaf were instead Bloodsong's Expose Weakness, the sourced value would be 1.08 (melee) / 1.05 (ranged) and both values would be wrong - but Expose Weakness is not a resistance reduction and neither golden value is near 1.08/1.05.
